_comment: Facts that only appear when two mods are installed TOGETHER, so no single-mod jar scan can find them. Each was verified by an agent reading guides or jars, not inferred.

shadowed.why: Create Connected ships its own copycat blocks that SILENTLY MIGRATE into Copycats+ blocks when both mods are present. A quest asking for a create_connected:copycat_* item can never complete, because the item turns into the copycats: version in the player's inventory.

cross_mod_gates.why: Create Big Cannons does not add steel - the guide says so outright. Steel cannons, its whole endgame, are unreachable until TFMG's blast furnace line runs: cast iron -> coke oven -> fire clay -> blast stove -> blast furnace. Neither mod's jar mentions the other, so this dependency is invisible to any per-mod scan.
